sections.title: OTP Application
sections.description: Application entry point and supervision tree.
sections.content: Dashboard.Application starts the Phoenix endpoint, plugin registry, and other system services. It defines the supervision tree that ensures system processes are fault tolerant.
sections.code:
def start(_type, _args) do
  children = [
    Dashboard.PluginRegistry,
    Dashboard.PluginSupervisor,
    DashboardWeb.Endpoint
  ]
end
